tools.name: check_store
tools.description: Check a public WooCommerce store from the outside: is it reachable, is HTTPS valid and are redirects sane, is WooCommerce detected, do /cart/ and /checkout/ load, and are payment markers visible on checkout. Read-only: GET requests only, never adds to cart, logs in or submits forms. Returns pass/war

tools.name: check_ssl
tools.description: Check that a store's HTTPS certificate is accepted, http:// permanently redirects to https://, the redirect chain is short and stays on HTTPS, and an HSTS header is set. The exact certificate expiry date isn't visible to an outside fetch. Read-only: one run of GET requests only; never logs in, adds

tools.name: check_exposure
tools.description: Flag WordPress, WooCommerce, plugin and PHP versions a store shows publicly (generator tags, asset ?ver= values, X-Powered-By), a public /readme.html and a readable /wp-content/debug.log. Log contents are never returned or kept. Read-only: one run of GET requests only; never logs in, adds to cart or

tools.name: check_seo_basics
tools.description: Check a store's robots.txt (and whether it blocks the whole site), its XML sitemap, the homepage title and meta description, and noindex on the homepage. Read-only: one run of GET requests only; never logs in, adds to cart or submits forms. Nothing is monitored or saved; ongoing checks are Store Can

tools.name: check_speed
tools.description: Time one download each of a store's homepage, one product page and the cart from Cloudflare's network. One sample per page, not a lab test or an average. Read-only: one run of GET requests only; never logs in, adds to cart or submits forms. Nothing is monitored or saved; ongoing checks are Store Can

tools.name: check_products
tools.description: Read up to 10 published products from the public WooCommerce Store API and flag missing prices, missing images and out-of-stock items. Read-only: one run of GET requests only; never logs in, adds to cart or submits forms. Nothing is monitored or saved; ongoing checks are Store Canary Pro.

tools.name: check_policies
tools.description: Check that the homepage links to privacy, terms, shipping and returns/refunds pages, and that each linked page on the same site loads. Read-only: one run of GET requests only; never logs in, adds to cart or submits forms. Nothing is monitored or saved; ongoing checks are Store Canary Pro.

tools.name: explain_finding
tools.description: Explain a finding code returned by any Store Canary tool (for example ssl_hsts or exposure_debug_log) in plain words, with a suggested fix. Makes no network requests.
